description: KuCoin reserve sweep (real money on live fire): keeps `keep` units of `currency` in the futures wallet and moves the excess futures -> main -> trade in two legs carrying the same amount. Dry-run by default (plan only, zero bytes to the venue, no YOLO gate). Live fire (dryRun:false) needs the trade:execute scope AND user YOLO eligibility (kill switch off, autonomy != propose_only). KuCoin only.

connectionId.description: CEX connection id (see list_connections). Takes precedence over exchange.

currency.description: Settlement asset to sweep: USDT, USDC, BTC or ETH (XBT accepted as BTC; default USDT)

dryRun.description: Plan only, moves nothing (default true). Pass false to fire both transfer legs.

exchange.description: CEX slug — kucoin only (resolved to an active connection; connectionId wins when both are given)

keep.description: Units of currency to leave in futures (default 10)

name: reserve_sweep
title: Sweep KuCoin futures reserve to trade
